pull_requests.description: Implement approved spec: CLI Todo App Implementation

issues: Code does not implement the core functionalities as outlined in the spec, such as the creation, reading, updating, and deletion of todo items.
suggestions: Implement functions for creating, reading, updating, and deleting todo items in the CLI application.
Ensure that the json file (todos.json) is correctly read from and written to for data persistence.
Add unit tests to verify that the functionalities of the todo app are working as intended.

issues: The code currently does not implement the functionalities of creating, reading, updating, and deleting todo items, which are explicitly required by the specification.
The implementation lacks detail on how todo items are managed in the CLI, specifically the commands and user interactions.
suggestions: Implement the full CLI functionality for creating, reading, updating, and deleting todo items as per the spec.
Provide a clear outline of user commands in the README or comments within the code to explain how to use the application effectively.
Ensure data persistence by implementing file handling for todos (e.g., reading from and writing to 'todos.json').
Consider adding error handling for user input to improve user experience.

issues: The provided code does not implement the functionality to create, read, update, and delete todo items as specified in the requirements.
While the code provides a summary of the feature and includes notes about its functionality, it lacks the actual implementation of CLI commands for interacting with todo items.
No handling of the JSON data for persistence and management of todo items was found in the code.
suggestions: Develop specific functions for creating, reading, updating, and deleting todo items as outlined in the spec.
Include JSON file handling methods to ensure that todos are saved and loaded correctly between sessions.
Implement user input handling through the command line to allow interaction with the application, enabling the creation and management of todo items.

issues: The code provided does not implement all functionalities outlined in the spec. Specifically, there is no implementation for creating, reading, updating, deleting todo items, or managing their completion status.
suggestions: Implement the core functionalities for creating, reading, updating, and deleting todos in the command line interface.
Ensure that the application can manage the completion status of todo items as specified in the requirements.
Add functionality to save and read todo items from a file to meet the persistence specification.

issues: The current implementation is not providing any actual functionality to create, read, update, or delete todo items as specified. It is merely summarizing the feature requirements.
suggestions: Implement the core CRUD functionalities for todo items, including methods for creating, reading, updating, and deleting todos.
Ensure the application reads from and writes to a JSON file as stipulated to maintain data persistence.
Develop a command line interface that maps user commands to the corresponding CRUD operations.
